summary: Root cause (from source + prefab YAML, not verified at runtime): BotHealthBar.Setup binds the stun bar via GetComponentInParent<IStunComponent>(), which resolves to an EntityProxy (Spiked dogs via JunkDogSpikes, Armored dogs via ArmorEntity proxies on PhysicsRig) or a bubble GameEntity (Mantis/Ussam) that has no status effects, so the bar reads stunDamage=0 while the root entity accumulates stun normally. Bloodhound works because its armor only protects Head, which is not above the bar. Bombots are a separate cause: BombBotEntity.ModifyIncomingInteraction strips Damage.Type.Stun. Fix: walk the stun source up past GameEntities with hasStatusEffects=false (same approach as the existing health loop), and stop stripping Stun on bombots. The change is committed locally but not compiled (Unity was still doing a full asset import) and not pushed (git push permission was denied), so no PR exists.
instructions:
Bug: for a number of enemies, the stun bar UI does not visibly fill or change as the enemy takes stun-type damage, yet after enough qualifying hits the enemy does become stunned anyway. This happens on current master and was also confirmed present in build 12010, so it is not a regression from a recent change.

Affected enemies:
1. All junkdogs except the base junkdog and the bloodhound junkdog
2. All bombots
3. All jungledogs except the normal/base jungledog
4. All bosses

Known findings so far, to speed up the investigation:
- Bombots: there is a confirmed code bug, not a YAML/asset override issue. In BombBotEntity.cs, the method ModifyIncomingInteraction (around lines 71-79) strips Damage.Type.Stun from every incoming hit, so the stun bar can never fill from damage. Any stun bombots do end up receiving appears to come from a non-damage source (e.g. a hack/quirk) calling Stun() directly, bypassing the bar entirely. This needs to be fixed so stun-type damage actually accumulates in the stun bar instead of being stripped.
- Junkdogs/jungledogs (Armored/Spiked variants etc.): checked their data and all these variants inherit stunBuffer=50, same as the base versions — so this rules out a per-prefab stunBuffer value override as the cause. The actual cause for these enemies (and for bosses) is not yet confirmed and needs a live check in the editor to find where the stun bar UI fails to update despite the underlying stun accumulation working.

Task:
- Investigate and confirm the root cause for each of the four affected groups (junkdogs, bombots, jungledogs, bosses) — do not assume they all share one cause; bombots already have a distinct confirmed code-level cause, the others still need confirmation via live testing in the editor (e.g. checking whether the stun bar UI is bound/updating correctly for these enemy types, checking for YAML/asset overrides, and checking any shared vs per-type logic differences from the base/unaffected variants that do work correctly).
- Implement a fix so that the stun bar UI visibly fills/updates in sync with stun-type damage for all listed affected enemies, matching the correct working behavior seen on base junkdog, bloodhound junkdog, and normal/base jungledog.
- Done means: hitting any of the listed affected enemies with stun-type damage visibly updates their stun bar in real time, and the enemy still becomes stunned at the same point it does today (or as appropriate given the fix).
